verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Angular's first-party routing module ("first-party modules for forms, routing, and more") and CLI build/serve/deploy commands. None of it documents an official full-stack meta-framework built on top of Angular for server-side rendering, server routing, or data fetching. A built-in client router is an adjacent feature of the core framework, not the meta-framework this story asks about, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official full-stack meta-framework built on top of the framework for routing and data fetching
